quotes.text: Mansion. 1776-83, by John Carr in the Palladian style; some alterations and internal details by J.B. Papworth in 1839-42. 3:3:3:7:3:3:3 bay rhythm.
quotes.page: Official list entry 1221097, Details, opening sentence

quotes.text: Centre block: Bath stone ashlar with plinth, rusticated basement with raised band above, first floor cill string and string below cornice.
Central tetrastyle Ionic portico in antis over slightly projecting basement beneath with triangular pediment above.
Dentil cornice and parapet to hipped slate roof with six stacks and central light well.

Three storeys comprising basement, piano nobile, and attic; seven bays, glazing bar sashes. Attic windows with architraves, three in centre with two-light casements; first floor windows with balustrading beneath, architraves and cornices.

Pavilions: Bath stone ashlar with plinth, plat band above ground floor windows, first floor cill string and string below cornice. Dentil cornice with triangular pediment to slate roof with central ridge stack. Rectangular plan with recessed corners. Two storeys; three bays, glazing bar sashes, those on first floor with balustrading beneath, and arched on ground floor.
quotes.page: Official list entry 1221097, Details, Pavilions paragraph

quotes.text: Rear elevation: centre block of five bays with central canted bay and balustraded parapet. Central first floor Venetian window with Ionic columns and antae supporting frieze and cornice. Central ground floor half glazed double doors.
quotes.page: Official list entry 1221097, Details, rear elevation paragraph

quotes.text: Screen Walls: four walls, flanking each pavilion. Ashlar with plinth and raised band below alternating solid and balustraded parapet. One storey; three bays, glazing bar sashes and central six-panelled door with architrave and cornice.
quotes.page: Official list entry 1221097, Details, Screen Walls paragraph

measurements.name: storey_count
measurements.as_printed: Three storeys comprising basement, piano nobile, and attic
measurements.note: The entry counts the basement as one of the three, so there are two storeys above ground.

measurements.name: portico_column_count
measurements.as_printed: Central tetrastyle Ionic portico in antis
measurements.note: 'Tetrastyle' means four columns across the front. The entry does not print the numeral, so 4 is a reading of a term of art and is marked as one.

measurements.as_printed: Two storeys; three bays, glazing bar sashes

measurements.name: rear_bay_count

measurements.note: The rear elevation is five bays where the entrance front is seven; the difference is the canted bay in the centre.
